briefs.ai_summary: CONFIRMED FACTS: Online News Association (ONA) announced on November 10, 2026 that it is pausing in-person events and will NOT hold its annual conference in 2027. Long-time staff will leave in November; Patel continues with a board led by Andrew Fitzgerald. ONA will continue its Women's Leadership Accelerator and online activities. Primary evidence: https://www.journalists.org/news/a-strategic-shift-for-ona ; initial discovery: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQSTRyX2JXZjVfbGFIVWdFRllEY2Y1MllRN2xwbk5NZWp2WV94YWQxeV9QckZjMzdYbHhRQ1pqeF9vVVVYSVpJWC1wd0NGSnNIalNINmpIcjRlWE5oUVNxUWVPZXdXOGFNRmVrTVNqSWlzeGx4dk9jUEIzY3JROXhxWjU0UFRCRUpiZ29z?oc=5 . Cost pressure may eventually make a smaller-format cost review relevant, conditional on a concrete event decision. COUNTEREVIDENCE: The explicit cancellation of the 2027 conference defeats any claim of an open 2027 hotel/conference RFP; staffing reductions and cost constraints make a paid outside engagement especially uncertain. OPEN QUALIFICATION QUESTIONS: Will ONA resume an in-person event in 2028 or later, and at what scale? Current disposition: watch for a newly approved event cycle; not an actionable pre-RFP conference lead.

The saved evidence also records 250+ attendees, about 150–160 peak room nights, an anticipated November 2026 hotel/CVB bidding phase and ALP's stated internal end-to-end conference management. Source: https://www.alpleaders.org/2028_site_selection.php . RESEARCH CLUES: The process supplies unusually concrete event scale and a time-sensitive vendor decision to verify. COUNTEREVIDENCE: Public host selection is already underway, formal hotel bids may be imminent or initiated, and ALP's internal planning capability weighs against a full-service external-planner pitch. The saved lodging figure is not a verified current event budget or guaranteed savings. OPEN QUALIFICATION QUESTIONS: Was the host LOI chosen, and have November 2026 bids been requested or contracts signed? Who negotiates hotel/F&B/AV terms, and does an incumbent adviser have exclusivity? What actual 2028 event spend is available for comparison? Is there a discrete independent cost-audit scope, and would ALP pay for it? Can Robert deliver that scope solo? Prioritize verification of possible disqualification; do not mark pre-RFP or outreach-ready.
